title: Typed integral realization coordinates
statement: integralCoordinateIso is precisely the specified integral realization comparison R.integral E, with source tensorStage l X E followed by ordinary l X R, and target the integral constructible inclusion followed by pbcDerivedExtend of coefficientMap l X R E. It introduces no data or choices. The explicit type prevents proof elaboration from unfolding the large native module equivalence merely to identify its source and target. The proved finite_tensor_coordinates equation extracts N.integral_tensor after postcomposition by the inverse stage tensor isomorphism and the integral realization. The proved integral_pull_coordinates equation expresses the inverse comparison followed by the stage pullback and integral realization as ordinary pullback of the integral realization followed by finiteIntegralPullMap. Both follow by cancelling the specified invertible comparisons.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15, printed pp. 61-62; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Lemma 7.9.
source.note: The explicit postcomposition is the cancellation stage in the fixed-field representative calculation.

proof.text: For finite_tensor_coordinates, substitute N.integral_tensor, expand the two displayed stage coordinates, and cancel the mapped stage isomorphism and integral realization inverse.

For integral_pull_coordinates, substitute integralRealizationAgreement, express its right side as e.hom followed by d.inv and f.inv, and precompose by the comparison homomorphism. Cancel each inverse pair.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; explicit separation of the finite scalar square from raw coefficient-stage transport.

def integralCoordinateIso (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (R : LocallyFiniteAdicRealization.Realization l X)
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) :
    tensorStage l X E ⋙ ordinary l X R ≅
      (sfIntegralConstructible l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).ι ⋙
        pbcDerivedExtend (coefficientMap l X R E)
